execution: rush CLI through Docker Compose with compose.source-access.yaml, from the TCR-003 working tree before its first commit

credential.observation: The MCP server accepted a ClickUp personal token as a bearer credential although ClickUp's MCP FAQ says only OAuth is supported. The same token sent without the Bearer prefix was rejected with HTTP 401.

references: The owner approved one workspace, one task and one Doc page. Their IDs are kept in local configuration and are not recorded here. The task is real project data, not a fictional demo item.

controlled_live_failures.case: Reference not on the approved list
controlled_live_failures.message: The ticket reference is not approved; no request was sent

controlled_live_failures.case: Deliberately invalid personal token in place of the real one
controlled_live_failures.message: ClickUp rejected the configured credential; replace CLICK_UP_API_TOKEN or run rush source-connect

controlled_live_failures.case: Deliberately invalid stored OAuth token with a placeholder client record
controlled_live_failures.message: ClickUp authorization is required; run rush source-connect

not_verified: A live interactive OAuth sign-in, its granted scope, access-token lifetime and whether a refresh token is issued
Revocation of the real token or a real OAuth grant; no shared credential was revoked
Whether a personal token regenerated in ClickUp invalidates the previous one immediately
That the approved task belongs to the approved workspace; ClickUp returned it for the token's user
content_policy: Content hashes and lengths only. Raw responses, page text and resource IDs were not saved. Hashes describe a point-in-time response that can change when the source changes.
